documents.title: Synthetic evaluation document — threshold-plan
documents.text: Synthetic candidate G is seeking funding for a confirmatory human exposure/safety study. The reviewed clinical plan defines a scientific gate: achieve the pre-specified target exposure in the stated adult population, with no severe treatment-related event during the stated follow-up and a reproducible assay result. The study is feasible at the current stage; recruitment and assay access are documented as available. No study outcome has yet been reported. Prices, full budget, patent rights and partner commitments are not supplied. This is a necessary scientific gate, not a complete investment approval criterion.

documents.title: Synthetic evaluation document — threshold-result
documents.text: Synthetic candidate G follow-up confirms the exact population, target exposure, assay reproducibility and follow-up from the reviewed gate plan. The pre-specified target exposure was achieved, assay replication was successful, and no severe treatment-related event occurred during the specified follow-up. Independent reviewers of this fictional study verified the result against the pre-specified criteria. The findings are limited to this population and follow-up; clinical efficacy, longer-term safety, full budget and commercial/IP readiness remain unestablished.
